sliders.jump: Lực nhảy x (1.0-3.0, step 0.2) -> GameVarDef.JSDeadGhostJumpScale (0x4380). ELGCCFOEIID uses h = MaxJumpHeight * JSDeadGhostJumpScale * scaleMap and v0 = sqrt(h * -2 * RisingGravity), gravity unchanged, so apex scales linearly with the slider.
sliders.speed: Tốc chạy x (1.0-2.0, step 0.1) -> PlayerAttributes.RunSpeedUpScale. GetSpeedByType multiplies GetBaseSpeedBySpeedType by GetSpeedScaleBySpeedType, so this also raises airborne steering.
sliders.bay: Bay gravity (9.8 = off, 0-9.8 step 0.25) -> get_CustomGravity / get_FallingGravity hooks.
